description: Derived from AGSC-08-07: when `prov.origin` is `ai-assisted` or `ai-generated`, an Assisted-by line naming the operator MAY be added beside the Signed-off-by line, and when one is present its operator MUST match `prov.operator`, else AGSC-E505. Each sub-case is a well-formed DCO-Plus trailer block (AGSC-08-06, the grammar `prov-0005` pins) beside the `prov` of the change it signs, with a fictitious contributor and a neutral producer. operator-matches: an ai-assisted change whose Assisted-by line names its operator, no finding. operator-differs: an ai-assisted change whose Assisted-by line names another operator, AGSC-E505. line-absent: an ai-generated change with no Assisted-by line, no finding, because the line is optional. human-origin: a change of origin `human` whose Assisted-by line names another operator, no finding, because the rule binds the two ai-* origins only. `codes` is the whole list of codes the check reports for the block.

trailers.block:
Signed-off-by: Ada Example <ada@example.org> (CA-v1)
Assisted-by: example-model/1.0 (operator: human:ada)
trailers.name: operator-matches
